Terms & Conditions

Last updated: 25 August 2026

1. Introduction

These Terms & Conditions ("Terms") govern your use of the Stagona mobile application (the "App"), operated by the Limassol District Local Government Organisation – EOA Lemesos (the "Organisation", "we", "us"), a legal person governed by public law established under Law 37(I)/2022, 66–76 Franklin Roosevelt Avenue, 3012 Limassol, Cyprus. By downloading, accessing or using the App you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the App.

2. The service

Stagona is a smart water demand-management service that lets consumers of the Organisation link their water meter(s), view water-consumption information, receive notifications (including possible-leak and high-consumption alerts), access water-saving content, and manage related preferences. The App is provided as a convenience tool and complements, it does not replace the Organisation's official services and records.

3. Eligibility and accounts

  • The App is for adults (18+). Minors are not permitted to authenticate for this service.

  • Sign-in is performed through the Cyprus Government CY Login identity service. You are responsible for your CY Login credentials and for all activity under your account.

  • You agree to provide accurate information and to keep your account secure. Notify us of any unauthorised use.

4. Meter linking and data accuracy

  • Linking a meter requires that you are entitled to access that meter's data (e.g. as the consumer or an authorised user). You must not link or attempt to access a meter you are not entitled to.

  • Consumption figures, charts, and alerts in the App are indicative and are provided for information only. They may be delayed, estimated, or incomplete, and are not a substitute for the Organisation's official meter readings, bills, or determinations. In case of any discrepancy, the Organisation's official records prevail.

  • Possible-leak and high-consumption alerts are best-effort aids and do not guarantee detection of every leak or the accuracy of every alert. You remain responsible for your plumbing, property, and water use.

5. Notifications

If you enable notifications, you consent to receive push notifications related to your meters and the service. You can manage or disable notifications at any time in the App or your device settings.

6. Acceptable use

You agree not to:

  • use the App unlawfully or in breach of these Terms;

  • access data or meters you are not authorised to access;

  • attempt to disrupt, reverse-engineer, probe, or compromise the App or its back-end, or circumvent security or authentication;

  • use automated means to extract data except as expressly permitted;

  • submit unlawful, offensive, or infringing content through feedback or other features.

7. Sharing meters with other users

The App may let you share access to a meter with other users. If you share access, you confirm you are entitled to do so, and you are responsible for whom you grant access to. You can revoke sharing where the App provides that option.

The App, its content, trademarks, and software are owned by or licensed to the Organisation and are protected by law. You are granted a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable licence to use the App for its intended purpose. No other rights are granted.

We aim to keep the App available but do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation. We may modify, suspend, or discontinue the App or any feature at any time, and may update the App for security, legal, or operational reasons.

10. Suspension and account deactivation

  • You may deactivate your account at any time in the App. Deactivation logs you out of all sessions; certain data may be retained as described in the Privacy Policy and as required by law.

  • We may suspend or restrict access where we reasonably believe these Terms have been breached or to protect the service, other users, or the Organisation.
